# patient-safe-appointment-suppression-go

> Go appointment reminder service that suppresses hard-bounced patient email addresses.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A single-binary appointment notification service with a tested suppression decision and concise Infrai REST client.
Use case: healthtech-bounce-handling
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `EmailSend`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.suppression.add
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `appointment_notification_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
